title: A quotient of a Noetherian complete local ring is a Noetherian complete local ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring which is complete, i.e. $\mathfrak m$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $I\subsetneq R$ be a proper ideal. Then $R/I$ is a Noetherian local ring, with maximal ideal $\bar{\mathfrak m}=\mathfrak m/I$, which is $\bar{\mathfrak m}$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0325 (lemma-quotient-complete-local, line 44811), first sentence ('Any quotient of R is also a Noetherian complete local ring'); proof via Lemma 00MA (lemma-completion-tensor)

proof.text: (Noetherian.) The quotient map R -> R/I is surjective, so Mathlib's isNoetherianRing_of_surjective gives IsNoetherianRing (R ⧸ I).

(Local and maximal ideal.) Properness gives Nontrivial (R ⧸ I), and the surjective quotient map gives its local-ring instance via IsLocalRing.of_surjective'. Mathlib's map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective identifies the maximal ideal of the quotient with the image of the maximal ideal of R.

(Completeness.) The quotient R/I is a finite R-module, so finite_module_complete_over_complete_noetherian gives completeness for the image of the maximal ideal under algebraMap R (R ⧸ I), using IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff. Rewriting by the maximal-ideal equality yields completeness for IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I).

lean.statement: theorem quotient_complete_local (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) : letI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hI letI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) := IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective IsNoetherianRing (R ⧸ I) ∧ IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ∧ IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)) (R ⧸ I)
